lead_independence.headline: Former AKC breeder arrested after Border Collies found covered in feces at Palm City home
lead_independence.lead: The Martin County Sheriffs Office executed a search warrant earlier Monday and spent much of the afternoon removing the animals, which ranged from puppies to adult Border Collies. Investigators wore hazmat suits as they worked to retrieve the dogs. Sheriff John Budensiek described the state of the home, saying the food bowls and water bowls in there are covered in feces. The animals themselves, the dogs, which are supposed to be Border Collies, beautiful dogs, are covered in feces. They're supposed to be white and black dogs, and they're solid black from the feces.
